event_name: NAPA Auto Parts NHRA Midwest Nationals

pairs.note:
Weather conditions: air temperature 79 degrees, relative humidity 45 percent, barometer 30.14 inches, adjusted
altitude 1,984 feet, track temperature 116 degrees.

Vandergriff and Hagan have each won 2 times against the other in prior events. 

Vandergriff with a couple ticks s on the tree and then the car gets real loose on the top end and close to the
wall.  He gets the win and is advancing to his seventh career final round and sixth this season.

Hagan was up in smoke right at the hit and clicked it off.

Prock is 7 - 6 against Beckman in prior events. 

Prock with the starting line advantage and the power to hold on for the hole shot win.  He will have lane
choice over Vandergriff in the final.  He is advancing to his third final this season and 35th of his career.
